items.text: A short, clean demo is the strongest item on a fresher teacher resume.
Principals read many fresher resumes that say "passionate about teaching".
These are rated for how far your own effort can scale beyond a salary.
Good explainers can reach many students through recorded lessons and small batches.
Who pays you Students and parents.

blocks.heading: How They Appear in Class
rows: Subject knowledge
Accurate answers, links across topics, handling unexpected questions
A one-page concept map with common student errors
Clear explanation
Short examples, analogies and checks for understanding
A recorded demo lesson of a short topic
Classroom management
Routines, seating, attention and respectful behaviour
A written plan for the first days with a class
Assessment
Questions that reveal misunderstanding, fair marking and feedback
A short test with a marking guide and feedback comments
Digital tools
Slides, shared documents and simple quizzes
A worksheet or quiz built with a free tool

rows: Corporate trainer or learning roles
Different audience and sometimes higher pay.
Needs business context.
Education administration
Operations and leadership.
Less time in the classroom.
